{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=5365704|text=STAR WARS: The Old Republic - Question ! :) - Page 3}} places ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' about ten to twelve [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], which is dated to [[3653 BBY]] by ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''. [[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 2|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 2]] takes place ten years after the treaty, one [[Standard week/Legends|week]] after the [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (Desolator crisis)|mission to Nar Shaddaa]], and around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[SpecForce Incident]]. Since the mission and the incident are respectively part of Act I of the [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] and [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Republic Trooper]]'s storylines, and the Trooper's Act I occurs concurrent to Act I of the [[Voidhound|Smuggler]] storyline, the general events of the Prologue and Act I for all classes can be assumed to occur in [[3643 BBY]].<noinclude>
